title: carthamus glaucus var. alexandrinus
intro: Carthamus glaucus var. alexandrinus, commonly known as Alexandrian senna or blue senna, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating constipation, diarrhea, and various skin conditions due to its purgative and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alexandrian senna are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and rhein, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
